title: both either neither
summary: Слова both, either и neither говорят о двух предметах или людях: оба, любой из двух, ни тот ни другой.
ru:
## both, either, neither — про ДВА предмета или человека
| слово | значение |
|---|---|
| **both** | оба, и тот и другой |
| **either** | любой из двух (один из двух) |
| **neither** | ни тот, ни другой |
> I have two sisters. **Both** are doctors. — У меня две сестры. Обе врачи.
> Tea or coffee? — **Either.** I don't mind. — Чай или кофе? — Любой.
> Cinema or theatre? — **Neither.** I want to stay at home. — Ни то, ни другое.

## С существительным
- **both** + **мн. число**: *both windows, both books*
- **either / neither** + **ед. число**: *either way, neither job*
> I liked **both cities**. — Мне понравились оба города.
> **Neither job** was interesting. — Ни одна из работ не была интересной.
> You can go **either way**. — Можно идти любой дорогой.

## both of / either of / neither of
После **of** нужно **the / these / those / my / her / Ann's ...** или местоимение:
> **Both of those pictures** are nice. (или *Both those pictures*)
> **Neither of my parents** is English. — Ни один из моих родителей не англичанин.
> I haven't read **either of these books**. — Я не читала ни одной из этих книг.
> Tom and I didn't eat. **Neither of us** was hungry. — Ни один из нас не был голоден.
> Do you know those two people? — I don't know **either of them**.

## either в отрицании
Не говорим ~~I don't want neither~~, потому что отрицание уже есть. Говорим:
> I don't want **either**. = I want **neither**. — Мне не нужен ни один.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Both of the books is good.~~ → **Both** of the books **are** good.
- ~~I don't like neither of them.~~ → I don't like **either** of them.
- ~~Neither book are good.~~ → **Neither** book **is** good.
- ~~Both my parents is doctors.~~ → Both my parents **are** doctors.
en:
## both, either, neither — for TWO things or people
| word | meaning |
|---|---|
| **both** | the one and the other |
| **either** | one or the other (it doesn't matter which) |
| **neither** | not the one and not the other |
> I have two sisters. **Both** are doctors.
> Tea or coffee? — **Either.** I don't mind.
> Cinema or theatre? — **Neither.** I want to stay at home.

## With a noun
- **both** + **plural**: *both windows, both books*
- **either / neither** + **singular**: *either way, neither job*
> I liked **both cities**. · **Neither job** was interesting. · You can go **either way**.

## both of / either of / neither of
After **of** we need **the / these / those / my / her / Ann's ...** or a pronoun:
> **Both of those pictures** are nice. (or *Both those pictures*)
> **Neither of my parents** is English.
> I haven't read **either of these books**.
> **Neither of us** was hungry.
> I don't know **either of them**.

## either in negatives
- ~~I don't want neither.~~ → I don't want **either**. = I want **neither**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I don't like neither of them.~~ → I don't like **either** of them.
- ~~Neither book are good.~~ → **Neither** book **is** good.
- ~~Both my parents is doctors.~~ → Both my parents **are** doctors.
structure:
## Три слова
| | с существительным | с of | без существительного |
|---|---|---|---|
| both | both + мн. число | both (of) the / my / these ... | both of them / both of us |
| either | either + ед. число | either of the / my / these ... | either of them |
| neither | neither + ед. число | neither of the / my / these ... | neither of us |

## Формулы
> **both** + мн. число + глагол во мн. числе
> **either / neither** + ед. число + глагол в ед. числе
> **neither of** + мн. число + глагол обычно в ед. числе: *Neither of my parents is English.*

## Отрицание
> **not ... either** = **neither**
> I don't like **either** of them. = I like **neither** of them.

I can't help you. I haven't got {{either}} of the keys.
— Are you going on Friday or Saturday? — {{Either}}. I'm free both days.
